Chapter 14.5, Calculation of Gross Heating Value, Specific Gravity, and Compressibility of Natural Gas Mixtures from Compositional Analysis, September 1981 (AGA 2172) (ANSI/API MPMS 14.5-1981)

This publication outlines a procedure for calculating, from compositional analysis, the following properties of natural gas mixtures: heating value, specific gravity, and compressibility factor. 4 pages.

Price each, $2.50
